cc:Work.dc:title: FlexBox - FlexBox5Plus
cc:Work.dc:description:
Box with living hinge and round corners, with optional turning latch, inner reinforcements and unfolding jig
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes FlexBox5Plus --reinforcements=2 --turn_latch=1 --flex_jig=1 --format=svg Command line short: boxes FlexBox5Plus --reinforcements=2 --turn_latch=1 --flex_jig=1
